interview_process.evidence_tier: Official company hiring guidance; role-specific details vary
interview_process.summary: The official hiring guide describes the following process. Confirm the exact loop for the role and level with the recruiter.

stages.name: Recruiter screen
stages.signal: A phone or video conversation about the candidate, role, and background.

stages.name: Team interview
stages.signal: A second conversation with one or two team members.

stages.name: Final round
stages.signal: Meet multiple colleagues across the business. The public guide does not specify a universal engineering round count or question set.

stages.name: Technical format and preparation
stages.signal: Most interviews are virtual; role-specific tools can include CoderPad. Prepare examples of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and the reasoning behind your results.

notes.label: Preparation context
notes.detail: Preparation inference from the product: recommendation and search systems, streaming delivery, experimentation, and data pipelines. These are study suggestions rather than confirmed question topics.
